questions.scenario: You are organizing a grand farewell party at school. What is your role?

options.text: Designing the beautiful invitation cards and posters.
Deciding the lighting, stage decoration, and seating arrangement.
Helping my friends choose the perfect outfits and styling.
Planning the exact flow so the food line doesn't get jammed.

questions.scenario: You enter a big shopping mall. What catches your attention first?

options.text: The cool logos, neon signs, and big advertising billboards.
The furniture, lighting, and how beautiful the stores look from inside.
The mannequins showing the latest jackets and trendy clothes.
If the mall map is easy to read or if I am getting lost.

questions.scenario: You download a brand new app on your phone. What makes you delete it immediately?

options.text: The colors are ugly and the text is hard to read.
It feels 'cluttered' and messy, like a dirty room.
It looks old-fashioned and out of style.
The buttons don't work easily and I can't find the menu.

questions.scenario: What is something you absolutely hate (Your biggest pet peeve)?

options.text: When someone uses 5 different fonts in one school presentation.
When a room is painted in a highly disturbing color.
When someone wears clothes that don't fit them properly.
When a door says 'Pull' but has a handle that makes you want to 'Push'.

questions.scenario: For a school craft project, which activity do you enjoy the most?

options.text: Sketching, coloring, or creating beautiful digital art.
Building a 3D cardboard model of a house or city.
Tie-dyeing an old t-shirt or making DIY jewelry.
Making a board game where the rules and steps are super fun.

questions.scenario: When you are watching a movie, what makes you pause and say 'Wow'?

options.text: The amazing movie poster and the title design.
The billionaire's massive, beautifully decorated mansion.
The main hero's incredibly stylish jacket and shoes.
The cool, futuristic gadgets that look so smooth to use.

questions.scenario: You have an empty, boring bedroom. How do you upgrade it first?

options.text: Hang up cool posters, polaroids, and aesthetic art.
Move the bed near the window and buy a cozy rug and lamp.
Buy a huge mirror and set up an open wardrobe for my outfits.
Arrange the study table so everything is exactly at an arm's reach.

questions.scenario: If you had a 'Design Superpower', what would it be?

options.text: Draw a perfect circle or logo with one hand stroke.
Snap my fingers and completely re-decorate a dusty room.
Magically change my outfit into anything instantly.
Make any confusing machine instantly easy for a grandparent to use.

questions.scenario: Which of these gifts would you love to receive?

options.text: A premium set of sketching pens or an iPad for digital drawing.
A beautiful neon sign or aesthetic lights for my room.
A limited edition pair of sneakers or a branded jacket.
A smart gadget that perfectly organizes my daily routine.

questions.scenario: Among your friend group, what is your secret title?

options.text: The Artist (Makes things look beautiful).
The Vibe-Setter (Creates the best atmosphere).
The Stylist (Knows the best trends).
The Problem-Solver (Makes things simple and easy).
